newsitem.title: UK: CSC opens Bilbao handling facility on May.
newsitem.headline: CSC opens Bilbao handling facility on May.

text.p: Cargo Service Centre(CSC) said it will launch its new Bilbao cargo handling operation on May 1.
The company, part of the KLM Royal Dutch Airlines NV group, added in a statement issued here that this will be the first independent handling operation at Bilbao airport.
The new 370 sq m facility represents a 10 million peseta investment and is located in Poligono Asuaran, around one kilometre from the airport, it added
CSC has two similar operations in Spain. These are at first is at Zaragoza which opened in 1995 and Barcelona which started on April 1 this year.

"Though airlines have been under-served (at Bilbao), certain parts of the economy, especially the value-added high-tech sectors, are boosting the volume of air cargo," CSC's General Manager for Spain, Emmanuel Bouleige. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
